ayahs.1: Is Allah ke liye tamaam tareefen sazawaar hain jo (ibtidaayan) aasmanon aur zameen ka paida karne wala aur do do teen teen chaar chaar paron wale farishton ko apna Paighambar (qaasid) banaane wala hai, makhlooq mein jo chaahe ziyaadati karta hai Allah Taala yaqeenan har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.2: Allah Taala jo rahmat logon ke liye khol de so is ka koi band karne wala nahin aur jis ko band kar de so is ke baad is ka koi jaari karne wala nahin aur wahi ghaalib hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.3: Logo! Tum par jo in'aam Allah Taala ne kiye hain unhein yaad karo. Kya Allah ke siwa aur koi bhi Khaaliq hai jo tumhein aasman-o-zameen se rozi pahunchaaye? Is ke siwa koi mabood nahin. Pas tum kahan ulte jaate ho.
ayahs.4: Aur agar yeh aap ko jhutlaayen to aap se pehle ke tamaam Rasool bhi jhutlaaye ja chuke hain. Tamaam kaam Allah hi ki taraf lautaaye jaate hain.
ayahs.5: Logo! Allah Taala ka wada sachcha hai tumhein zindagaani-e-dunya dhoke mein na daale, aur na dhoke-baaz shaytaan tumhein ghaflat mein daale.
ayahs.6: Yaad rakho! Shaytaan tumhara dushman hai, tum ise dushman jaano woh to apne giroh ko sirf is liye hi bulaata hai ke woh sab jahannam-waasil ho jaayen.
ayahs.7: Jo log kaafir hue un ke liye sakht saza hai aur jo log imaan laaye aur nek aamaal kiye un ke liye bakhshish hai aur (bahut) bada ajr hai.
ayahs.8: Kya pas woh shakhs jis ke liye us ke bure aamaal muzayyan kar diye gaye hain pas woh unhein achchha samajhta hai (kya woh hidayat-yaafta shakhs jaisa hai), (yaqeen maano) ke Allah jise chaahe gumraah karta hai aur jise chaahe raah-e-raast dikhaata hai. Pas aap ko un par gham kha kha kar apni jaan halaakat mein na daalni chaahiye, yeh jo kuchh kar rahe hain is se yaqeenan Allah Taala ba-khoobi waaqif hai.
ayahs.9: Aur Allah hi hawaayen chalaata hai jo baadalon ko uthaati hain phir hum baadalon ko khushk zameen ki taraf le jaate hain aur is se is zameen ko is ki maut ke baad zinda kar dete hain. Isi tarah dobaara jee uthna (bhi) hai.
ayahs.10: Jo shakhs izzat haasil karna chaahta ho to Allah Taala hi ki saari izzat hai, tamaam-tar suthre kalimaat isi ki taraf chadhte hain aur nek amal un ko buland karta hai, jo log buraaiyon ke daaon-ghaat mein lage rehte hain un ke liye sakht-tar azaab hai, aur un ka yeh makr barbaad ho jaayega.
ayahs.11: Logo! Allah Taala ne tumhein mitti se phir nutfa se paida kiya hai, phir tumhein jode jode (mard-o-aurat) bana diya hai, auraton ko haamila hona aur bachchon ka tawallud hona sab is ke ilm se hi hai, aur jo badi umr wala umr diya jaaye aur jis ki umr ghate woh sab kitaab mein likha hua hai. Allah Taala par yeh baat bilkul aasaan hai.
ayahs.12: Aur baraabar nahin do darya yeh meetha hai pyaas bujhaata peene mein khushgawaar aur yeh doosra khaari hai kadwa, tum in donon mein se taaza gosht khaate ho aur woh zewaraat nikaalte ho jinhein tum pehente ho. Aur aap dekhte hain ke badi badi kashtiyan paani ko cheerne-phaadne wali in daryaaon mein hain taake tum is ka fazl dhoondo aur taake tum is ka shukr karo.
ayahs.13: Woh raat ko din aur din ko raat mein daakhil karta hai aur aaftaab-o-mahtaab ko isi ne kaam mein laga diya hai. Har ek miyaad-e-muayyan par chal raha hai. Yehi hai Allah tum sab ka paalne wala isi ki saltanat hai. Jinhein tum is ke siwa pukaar rahe ho woh to khajoor ki guthli ke chhilke ke bhi maalik nahin.
ayahs.14: Agar tum unhein pukaaro to woh tumhari pukaar sunte hi nahin aur agar (bil-farz) sun bhi len to faryaad-rasi nahin karenge, balke qayamat ke din tumhare is shirk ka saaf inkaar kar jaayenge. Aap ko koi Haq Taala jaisa khabardaar khabren na dega.
ayahs.15: Aye logo! Tum Allah ke mohtaaj ho aur Allah be-niyaaz khoobiyon wala hai.
ayahs.16: Agar woh chaahe to tum ko fana kar de aur ek nayi makhlooq paida kar de.
ayahs.17: Aur yeh baat Allah ko kuchh mushkil nahin.
ayahs.18: Koi bhi bojh uthaane wala doosre ka bojh nahin uthaayega, agar koi giraan-baar doosre ko apna bojh uthaane ke liye bulaayega to woh is mein se kuchh bhi na uthaayega go qaraabat-daar hi ho. To sirf un hi ko aagaah kar sakta hai jo ghaaibana taur par apne Rabb se darte hain aur namazon ki paabandi karte hain aur jo bhi paak ho jaaye woh apne hi nafa ke liye paak hoga. Lautna Allah hi ki taraf hai.
ayahs.19: Aur andha aur aankhon wala baraabar nahin.
ayahs.21: Aur na chhaaon aur na dhoop.
ayahs.22: Aur zinda aur murde baraabar nahin ho sakte, Allah Taala jis ko chaahta hai suna deta hai, aur aap in logon ko nahin suna sakte jo qabron mein hain.
ayahs.23: Aap to sirf daraane wale hain.
ayahs.24: Hum ne hi aap ko haq de kar khushkhabri sunaane wala aur dar sunaane wala bana kar bheja hai aur koi ummat aisi nahin hui jis mein koi dar sunaane wala na guzra ho.
ayahs.25: Aur agar yeh log aap ko jhutla den to jo log in se pehle ho guzre hain unhon ne bhi jhutlaaya tha un ke paas bhi un ke Paighambar mojize aur saheefe aur roshan kitaaben le kar aaye the.
ayahs.26: Phir main ne in kaafiron ko pakad liya so mera azaab kaisa hua.
ayahs.27: Kya aap ne is baat par nazar nahin ki ke Allah Taala ne aasman se paani utaara phir hum ne is ke zariye se mukhtalif rangaton ke phal nikaale aur pahaadon ke mukhtalif hisse hain safed aur surkh ke in ki bhi rangaten mukhtalif hain aur bahut gehre siyaah.
ayahs.28: Aur isi tarah aadmiyon aur jaanwaron aur chaupaayon mein bhi baaz aise hain ke in ki rangaten mukhtalif hain, Allah se is ke wohi bande darte hain jo ilm rakhte hain waaqai Allah Taala zabardast bada bakhshne wala hai.
ayahs.29: Jo log Kitaabullah ki tilaawat karte hain aur namaz ki paabandi rakhte hain aur jo kuchh hum ne un ko ata farmaaya hai is mein se posheeda aur alaaniya kharch karte hain woh aisi tijaarat ke umeedwaar hain jo kabhi khasaara mein na hogi.
ayahs.30: Taake un ko un ki ujraten poori de aur un ko apne fazl se aur ziyaada de be-shak woh bada bakhshne wala qadrdaan hai.
ayahs.31: Aur yeh kitaab jo hum ne aap ke paas wahi ke taur par bheji hai yeh bilkul theek hai jo ke apne se pehli kitaabon ki bhi tasdeeq karti hai. Allah Taala apne bandon ki poori khabar rakhne wala khoob dekhne wala hai.
ayahs.32: Phir hum ne in logon ko (is) kitaab ka waaris banaaya jin ko hum ne apne bandon mein se pasand farmaaya. Phir baaze to in mein apni jaanon par zulm karne wale hain aur baaze in mein mutawassit darje ke hain aur baaze in mein Allah ki taufeeq se nekiyon mein taraqqi kiye chale jaate hain. Yeh bada fazl hai.
ayahs.33: Woh baaghaat mein hamesha rehne ke jin mein yeh log daakhil honge sone ke kangan aur moti pehnaaye jaayenge. Aur poshaak un ki wahan resham ki hogi.
ayahs.34: Aur kahenge ke Allah ka laakh laakh shukr hai jis ne hum se gham door kiya. Be-shak hamara Parwardigar bada bakhshne wala bada qadrdaan hai.
ayahs.35: Jis ne hum ko apne fazl se hamesha rehne ke maqaam mein la utaara jahan na hum ko koi takleef pahunchegi aur na hum ko koi khastagi pahunchegi.
ayahs.36: Aur jo log kaafir hain un ke liye dozakh ki aag hai na to un ki qaza hi aayegi ke mar hi jaayen aur na dozakh ka azaab hi un se halka kiya jaayega. Hum har kaafir ko aisi hi saza dete hain.
ayahs.37: Aur woh log is mein chillaayenge ke aye hamare Parwardigar! Hum ko nikaal le hum achchhe kaam karenge bar-khilaaf in kaamon ke jo kiya karte the, (Allah kahega) kya hum ne tum ko itni umr na di thi ke jis ko samajhna hota woh samajh sakta aur tumhare paas daraane wala bhi pahuncha tha, so maza chakho ke (aise) zaalimon ka koi madadgaar nahin.
ayahs.38: Be-shak Allah Taala jaanne wala hai aasmanon aur zameen ki posheeda cheezon ka, be-shak wahi jaanne wala hai seenon ki baaton ka.
ayahs.39: Wahi aisa hai jis ne tum ko zameen mein aabaad kiya, so jo shakhs kufr karega is ke kufr ka wabaal isi par padega. Aur kaafiron ke liye un ka kufr un ke Parwardigar ke nazdeek naaraazgi hi badhne ka baais hota hai, aur kaafiron ke liye un ka kufr khasaara hi badhne ka baais hota hai.
ayahs.40: Aap kahiye! Ke tum apne qaraardaad shareekon ka haal to batlaao jin ko tum Allah ke siwa pooja karte ho. Yaani mujh ko yeh batlaao ke unhon ne zameen mein se kaun sa (juz) banaaya hai ya un ka aasmanon mein kuchh saajha hai ya hum ne un ko koi kitaab di hai ke yeh is ki daleel par qaaim hon, balke yeh zaalim ek doosre se nire dhoke ki baaton ka wada karte aate hain.
ayahs.41: Yaqeeni baat hai ke Allah Taala aasmanon aur zameen ko thaame hue hai ke woh tal na jaayen aur agar woh tal jaayen to phir Allah ke siwa aur koi un ko thaam bhi nahin sakta. Woh haleem ghafoor hai.
ayahs.42: Aur in kuffaar ne badi zordaar qasam khaayi thi ke agar un ke paas koi daraane wala aaye to woh har ek ummat se ziyaada hidayat qubool karne wale hon. Phir jab un ke paas ek Paighambar aa pahunche to bas un ki nafrat hi mein izaafa hua.
ayahs.43: Dunya mein apne ko bada samajhne ki wajah se, aur un ki buri tadbeeron ki wajah se aur buri tadbeeron ka wabaal in tadbeer walon hi par padta hai, so kya yeh isi dastoor ke muntazir hain jo agle logon ke saath hota raha hai. So aap Allah ke dastoor ko kabhi badalta hua na paayenge, aur aap Allah ke dastoor ko kabhi muntaqil hota hua na paayenge.
ayahs.44: Aur kya yeh log zameen mein chale phire nahin jis mein dekhte-bhaalte ke jo log in se pehle ho guzre hain un ka anjaam kya hua? Halaanke woh quwwat mein in se badhe hue the, aur Allah aisa nahin hai ke koi cheez is ko hara de na aasmanon mein aur na zameen mein. Woh bade ilm wala, badi qudrat wala hai.
ayahs.45: Aur agar Allah Taala logon par un ke aamaal ke sabab daar-o-geer farmaane lagta to roo-e-zameen par ek jaandaar ko na chhodta, lekin Allah Taala un ko ek miyaad-e-muayyan tak mohlat de raha hai, so jab un ki woh miyaad aa pahunchegi Allah Taala apne bandon ko aap dekh lega.
